module.purpose: Provides the internal React renderer that coordinates viewport behavior, pane interactions, selection state, keyboard shortcuts, and rendered children.
module.summary: This module composes viewport and pane primitives into a renderer for an interactive graph. It derives panning and selection behavior from keyboard state, configured interaction props, and global store selections, then forwards the resulting behavior to nested visual components. It also installs global deletion and multi-selection keyboard handling while conditionally rendering the node-selection overlay.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive graph editing and visualization in the React product surface. Failure would disrupt panning, zooming, node selection, keyboard accessibility, and pane event handling.
classes: FlowRendererProps (~L13-30): Defines renderer configuration and child-content requirements for graph interactions
functions: FlowRendererComponent (~L38-140): Coordinates keyboard, store, viewport, pane, and node-selection behavior

boundaryConditions.intent: Determines whether browser-specific keyboard handling can target the global window.
Prevents selection-on-drag from being active with explicitly enabled drag panning.

invariants.description: Effective panning is enabled when the pan activation key is pressed or configured panning is enabled.
Selection-on-drag is disabled whenever effective drag panning is exactly true.
The pane receives a boolean selection state even when no selection condition is active.
The viewport contains the pane, and the pane contains children before the optional selection overlay.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies properties compatible with the omitted graph-view options and provides renderable children.
The shared store exposes nodesSelectionActive and userSelectionActive fields on ReactFlowState.
Keyboard hooks accept an undefined target during server-side rendering.

ambiguities.question: Does the global keyboard hook register listeners immediately or defer them until a browser effect?
What exact interaction semantics do ZoomPane and Pane apply to the forwarded flags and callbacks?

concurrencyModel.notes: Rendering is synchronous and state changes are managed through React and Zustand hooks; keyboard subscriptions may update across renders.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the selection key is pressed while pan-on-drag is enabled, dragging must not pan the viewport.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Selection-key precedence prevents viewport panning during node selection.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When selection-on-drag is requested and pan-on-drag is not active, selection dragging must be enabled.
moduleContractTests.then: ZoomPane and Pane receive selectionOnDrag === true
moduleContractTests.rationale: Selection-on-drag is explicitly disabled whenever pan-on-drag is active.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the store reports that node selection is active, the node selection overlay must be rendered.
moduleContractTests.rationale: The store-controlled selection state determines whether the selection overlay exists.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the store reports that node selection is inactive, the node selection overlay must not be rendered.
moduleContractTests.rationale: Inactive selection must not add selection UI to the pane.

preconditions: The supplied props conform to FlowRendererProps<NodeType>.
postconditions: A ZoomPane containing a Pane is rendered with the supplied viewport, interaction, selection, and callback configuration.
NodesSelection is rendered inside the Pane when nodesSelectionActive is true.
invariants: panOnDrag is true when panActivationKeyPressed is true or the supplied panOnDrag value is truthy.
panOnScroll is true when panActivationKeyPressed is true or the supplied panOnScroll value is truthy.
selectionOnDrag is enabled only when the supplied selectionOnDrag is truthy and panOnDrag is not strictly true.
ZoomPane panOnDrag is disabled while selectionKeyPressed is true.
Pane receives the computed panOnDrag value, while ZoomPane receives the computed value additionally gated by selectionKeyPressed.
The rendered isSelecting value is always boolean.
edgeCases: When selectionOnDrag is false, the computed selectionOnDrag value passed to ZoomPane and Pane is false.
When selectionKeyPressed is true, ZoomPane receives panOnDrag as false even if computed panOnDrag is enabled; Pane still receives the computed panOnDrag value.
When nodesSelectionActive is false, no NodesSelection child is rendered.
When panActivationKeyPressed is true, it enables both computed panning modes regardless of the corresponding supplied panOnDrag or panOnScroll values.
detail.summary: Renders the flow viewport and pane while coordinating keyboard-driven panning, selection state, viewport configuration, and pane interaction callbacks.

specTests.then: The nested Pane receives panOnDrag enabled, but ZoomPane receives panOnDrag as false.
The computed panOnDrag and panOnScroll values are enabled, and the computed selectionOnDrag value is false.
The Pane is rendered without a NodesSelection child.
